info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Chervil Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Chervil Drill Detail Catalog API enables users to establish and enhance the catalog details for Chervil drills. Designed to support catalog management, it provides operations for adding new drill specifications and updating existing entries. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product specialists seeking to maintain accurate product information. This API streamlines the process of catalog creation, ensuring that detailed and up-to-date specifications are readily available for stakeholders.

post.summary: Create details for a chervil drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a chervil drill. It accepts the necessary data in the request body to successfully generate new details and processes the information accordingly.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details related to the Chervil drill. This JSON object should include all necessary attributes required for the operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogChervilDrillDetailRequest.title: Chervil Drill Request Body

chervil_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Chervil drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of chervil drills requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of each chervil drill.

tags.description: A list of tags for categorizing the request.

items.description: Tags associated with the chervil drill request.
